create_TestStream: create a TestStream instance that constructs in-memory train and test datasets at runtime
use_get_dataset_by_key: use get_dataset_by_key on a TestStream to retrieve a dataset by its string key
iterate_events: iterate over TestStream events to get TrainingEvent and PredictionEvent objects in sequence
review_TestStream_init: review the TestStream constructor to understand how train and test datasets are keyed and ordered
test_TestStream: test the TestStream class by asserting it yields four events alternating between training and prediction
